name: Dorm Room Fund
identity_check: Confirmed as Dorm Room Fund (dormroomfund.com, 'DRF'), the student-run pre-seed investor First Round Capital started on Penn's campus in 2012. Its own blog and team page say it went independent in 2022 with Dorm Room Fund IV (SEC EDGAR entity 'Dorm Room Fund IV, LP', Brooklyn NY); First Round stayed on as an LP (Fortune). The site describes writing the first check for founders still in school or just out, with student investment partners in four regions (BOS & Northeast, SF & West Coast, PHL & Southeast, NYC & Midwest) and a full-time team of Molly Fowler and Madison Jacox. Not First Round Capital itself, not a university-run student fund, not a scout program, and not the unrelated London startup 'Dorm'.

thesis_text.value: Writes the first check, often the first money in, for companies founded by current students and recent alumni (up to about two years post-graduation) and by its own alumni network, taking about 3% for $90K–$500K. Student partners on roughly 30 campuses source deals; a small full-time team supports; portfolio spans enterprise, dev tools, hardware, health, fintech, consumer, climate.
